title: GCP-6: Add max slot claim duration (e.g. 30-60 min)
description:
Current spec only checks expiry > now, no upper bound. A griefer can claim slots with expiry = now + 10 years and squat forever.

Add validation step: expiry <= now + MAX_CLAIM_DURATION_SEC (suggest 30-60 min default, Kconfig tunable).

Touches:
- spec/08-gateway-coordination.md (GCP-6.5 validation steps)
- lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_slot_coord.c (add check after expiry > now)
- Kconfig for CONFIG_LICHEN_SLOT_CLAIM_MAX_DURATION_SEC

Short leases force regular renewal, which:
1. Costs squatters airtime/battery to maintain
2. Lets legitimate nodes reclaim abandoned slots faster
3. Matches mesh topology churn reality
